topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Ran across a fella down at the terminal, suit all wet from the drizzle. Says he missed his flight, a delay or some such nonsense that’s got him rattled. Important event, he tells me, voice cracking like a dry twig. Not the first time I seen someone lose their cool over a little mix-up. Told him, life’s got a way of throwing wrenches, best to keep your head and maybe there’s a way to salvage the evening. Not every missed turn means the end of the road. Got him a drink, maybe it'll settle his nerves.
